Author: Asteria Nocturna
Name: Divination.AetheryteLinkInChat
Punchline: Quick teleport for mob hunts and treasure hunts!
Description:
Display a teleport link to the nearest aetherite for the map link from the in-game chat. Type /alic to configure the plugin.

This is a frozen build for Dalamud API 13 (e.g. the Traditional Chinese client) and will not receive further updates.
Changelog: Frozen build of 7.3.1.14 for Dalamud API 13.
